title: Add four new Note categories across Notes filters and Add/Edit Note modal

requirements.text: Update the Notes page category filter tabs to include four new categories: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", displayed alongside the existing tabs (All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other) and styled identically to the existing category tabs.

quotes:
Add four new note categories to the Notes page:

1. Add these new category filter tabs on the Notes page (next to the existing All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other tabs):
   - "LDC"
   - "Food Service"
   - "Personal"
   - "Family"

4. Style the new category tabs to match the existing ones.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Notes page, the category filter tab row includes: All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other, LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
Clicking each new tab filters the notes list to only notes whose category exactly matches that tab name (e.g., "Food Service").
The new tabs use the same Button variants, spacing, hover behavior, and active styling logic as existing tabs.
All existing tabs remain present and unchanged in label and behavior.

requirements.text: Update the Add Note modal category dropdown to include four new selectable category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", without changing, removing, or renaming any existing category options.

quotes:
2. Make sure these new categories appear in:
   - The "Add Note" modal category dropdown

3. Keep all existing categories exactly as they are - just add the four new ones.

acceptanceCriteria: In the Add Note modal, the Category select includes options for: LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
All pre-existing Category options remain present and unchanged.
A user can create a note with each of the new categories selected, and the note saves successfully.

requirements.text: Ensure the Edit Note modal category dropdown (when editing an existing note) includes the same four new category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", and that existing notes with these categories can be viewed and saved without category validation/type errors.

quotes:
2. Make sure these new categories appear in:
   - The "Edit Note" modal category dropdown (if it exists)

acceptanceCriteria: When editing a note, the Category select includes options for: LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
If an existing note has category "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", or "Family", opening the Edit Note modal preselects and displays that category correctly.
Saving an edited note with any of the new categories succeeds.

constraints: Keep all existing note categories exactly as they are; do not rename, remove, or reorder existing category labels beyond appending the four new ones.
Keep everything else on the Notes page and Add/Edit Note modal unchanged aside from adding the four new category options/tabs.
nonGoals: Adding or changing backend schemas or validation rules for note categories.
Changing category badge colors or other visual elements unrelated to the filter tabs and category dropdown options.
